description: This bar chart illustrates the "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" for two different models under three experimental conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "GPT-4o" and "GPT-4o-mini", arranged from left to right. The vertical value axis is labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 0.25. The chart utilizes grouped bars, where each model category on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of three bars representing different conditions as defined by the legend located at the top: "Control" (light gray), "Before Introspection Training" (light blue), and "After Introspection Training" (dark purple). For the GPT-4o category, the light gray Control bar has a value of approximately 0.10, the light blue Before Introspection Training bar is approximately 0.55, and the dark purple After Introspection Training bar is approximately 0.74. For the GPT-4o-mini category, the light gray Control bar is the shortest in the chart at approximately 0.02, the light blue Before Introspection Training bar is approximately 0.51, and the dark purple After Introspection Training bar is the tallest in the chart at approximately 0.75. Each bar includes a thin, vertical black error bar with caps, which the figure caption notes indicate 95% HDIs. The bars within each group are not sorted by height, but rather follow the consistent order defined in the legend, and no specific bars are visually emphasized beyond their assigned categorical colors.
